newsitem.title: UK: BOE says sold 18.1 bln stg of gilts to end-August.
newsitem.headline: BOE says sold 18.1 bln stg of gilts to end-August.

text.p: The Bank of England said on Friday it had sold 18.1 billion stg of gilts up to the end of August.
It has also raised 200 million stg through tap/auction sales.

For the 1996/97 financial year as a whole, the Bank said it will have to sell 39.9 billion stg of gilts to cover a forecast central government borrowing requirement of 28.1 billion stg, gilt redemptions of 12.5 billion stg and an estimated underfunding from 1995/96 of 2.1 billion stg.
Offsetting that, the Bank expects a three billion stg net inflow from national savings but a 200 million stg outflow from sales of certificates of tax deposit.
